summary: Unusual Machines, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a long-term lease for approximately 14,000 square feet of manufacturing space in Orlando, Florida, to support its battery business. There are no special-situation indicators such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, management changes, or other extraordinary corporate events. This filing is a routine current report regarding a material definitive agreement (lease) and a press release, which does not constitute a special situation.
